body:
I just wanted to post this short and simple.
I've tried this 5x and 10x salvia I got and never tripped, I smoked 2 bowls of each, just felt high no trip.
The 20x however, something weird happens each time, I've tripped on it 3 times now.
It feels like I'm trying to get out of the trip and everytime I do it finds a way to create a brand new reality starting all over where I'm trying to get out.  Its like sometimes I dissolve into objects, or just become the end of a object like the tip of a french fry or lawnmower blade, or sometimes its deeper then that, but its so weird, so hard to explain.  It's like pages of reality in a book just going into one another, or an episode of the twilight zone.
